title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
summary: Group a binary tree's values by level, reading the first level left to right, the next right to left, and so on.

tests.explain: Level 1 left to right: [1]. Level 2 right to left: [3, 2]. Level 3 left to right again: [4, 5, 6, 7].
One level, read left to right.

hints: Start from the ordinary level-order traversal: the levels are the same, only the reading direction changes.
Keep a flag that flips after every level. Don't change the order in which you enqueue children; change where each value is written.
On a right-to-left level, write the i-th dequeued value at index size - 1 - i of the level's array (or reverse the finished level).

complexity.time: O(n): every node is enqueued and dequeued once
complexity.space: O(w) for the queue (plus O(n) for the output)
